en: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
ar: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُقۡضَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَحۡيُهُۥۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمٗا

nb.en: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.

en: And [by] He who created the male and female,

nb.en: And [by] the day when it appears

en: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

nb.en: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."

en: From what substance did He create him?

nb.en: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.

en: And He made them like eaten straw.

nb.en: Striking them with stones of hard clay,

en: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water

nb.en: And made [therein] a burning lamp

en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah. Indeed, association [with him] is great injustice."
ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَ لُقۡمَٰنُ لِٱبۡنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَٰبُنَيَّ لَا تُشۡرِكۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرۡكَ لَظُلۡمٌ عَظِيمٞ

nb.en: And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

en: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],

nb.en: And [by] Mount Sinai

en: [That] you will surely experience state after state.

nb.en: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

en: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
ar: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ

nb.en: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

en: Cursed were the companions of the trench

nb.en: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

en: Then He eased the way for him;

nb.en: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

en: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِۖ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

nb.en: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.

en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

nb.en: And gardens of entwined growth.

en: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ شَأۡنٞ يُغۡنِيهِ

nb.en: And his wife and his children,

en: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ

nb.en: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

en: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -

nb.en: I swear by this city, Makkah -

en: No! But you deny the Recompense.

nb.en: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

en: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
ar: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمۡشُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هَوۡنٗا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا

nb.en: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.

en: And he is going to be satisfied.

nb.en: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.

en: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.

nb.en: And have shown him the two ways?

en: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
ar: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا

nb.en: And you love wealth with immense love.

en: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

nb.en: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.

en: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

nb.en: And those who arrange [each] matter,

en: Recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows that which you do.
ar: ٱتۡلُ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلَذِكۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُونَ

nb.en: Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

en: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -

nb.en: You are not over them a controller.

en: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

nb.en: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

en: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

nb.en: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -

en: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

nb.en: The Prophet frowned and turned away

en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
ar: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

nb.en: Because your Lord has commanded it.
